crossRefs.note: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.
Moreover I have heard the groaning of the children of Israel, whom the Egyptians keep in bondage, and I have remembered…
Therefore tell the children of Israel, ‘I am Yahweh, and I will bring you out from under the burdens of the Egyptians…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I have made you as God to Pharaoh; and Aaron your brother shall be your prophet.
But Yahweh has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance…
and Yahweh showed great and awesome signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
you shall not be afraid of them. You shall remember well what Yahweh your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt:
the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, the wonders, the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which…
Know this day—for I don’t speak with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the chastisement of Yahweh…
I gave to Isaac Jacob and Esau: and I gave to Esau Mount Seir, to possess it. Jacob and his children went down into…
for it is Yahweh our God who brought us and our fathers up out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage, and who…
“When Jacob had come into Egypt, and your fathers cried to Yahweh, then Yahweh sent Moses and Aaron, who brought your…
“You saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heard their cry by the Red Sea,
Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when…
how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,
They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
I will give this people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, and it will happen that when you go, you shall not go…
But every woman shall ask of her neighbor, and of her who visits her house, jewels of silver, jewels of gold, and…
The children of Israel did according to the word of Moses; and they asked of the Egyptians jewels of silver, and jewels…
Yahweh gave the people favor in the sight of the Egyptians, so that they let them have what they asked. They plundered…
He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

translations.web: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;
translations.bsb: But I will judge the nation they serve as slaves, and afterward they will depart with many possessions.
translations.kjv: And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
translations.asv: and also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance.
